Figure 5 compares WT and Kdm6b-mutant RNA profiles and histological measurements. Original litter/sex-adjusted differential-expression statistics are retained; `pipeline/05_RNA_and_pseudobulk.Rmd` distinguishes these results from the separate multiome pseudobulk PCA.

Histology measurements are parsed with mouse, section, hemisphere and anatomical region recorded separately. Biological summaries average within mouse before comparing groups; sections are not counted as independent animals. The supplied Figure 5g/h grids contain one WT and one mutant mouse each, so no additional biological replicates or significance tests are inferred. The original Figure 5d GO output is not available in the supplied inputs.

## Inputs and saved objects

Paths are relative to the `CortexCode/` directory. **saved-results** inputs support routine rendering; **optional-rerun** inputs are read only when the corresponding analysis is enabled. Wildcards identify file collections.

| Mode | Input path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Fig5_KC/*.csv` | Fig5_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Extended_Fig7_KC/*.csv` | Extended_Fig7_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |

| saved-results | `data/upstream/RNA/sample_metadata.csv` | 15-library biological metadata checked against RPKM rows |

See [input locations](INPUTS.md), [saved R objects](SAVED_OBJECTS.md) and the [complete file inventory](config/file_inventory.csv) for original source names, sizes and availability. These large inputs are not part of the Git checkout.

## RNA biological-process enrichment with topGO

The code below adapts the recovered Neurona topGO implementation (weight01 Fisher primary, classic Fisher diagnostic) to mouse annotation. It includes the tested-gene universe, Ensembl-to-Entrez mapping, foreground selection, graph-aware testing and complete term statistics. **The original CortexCode Figure 5d plotting output and exact topGO configuration were not recovered.** Therefore node size and DE-selection thresholds must be supplied explicitly; Neurona’s human annotation or thresholds are not represented as historical CortexCode settings. BH columns are supplementary summaries of graph-dependent tests, not a replacement for the primary weight01 P values. This optional rerun does not certify reproduction of Figure 5d.

```{r rna-topgo, eval=isTRUE(params$run_topgo)}
library(topGO)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(GO.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

run_topgo_bp <- function(universe_entrez, foreground_entrez, node_size, primary_algorithm = "weight01") {
  universe_entrez <- unique(as.character(na.omit(universe_entrez)))
  foreground_entrez <- intersect(
    unique(as.character(na.omit(foreground_entrez))),
    universe_entrez
  )
  stopifnot(
    length(universe_entrez) > 0, length(foreground_entrez) > 0
  )
  selected <- factor(
    as.integer(universe_entrez %in% foreground_entrez),
    levels = c(0, 1)
  )
  names(selected) <- universe_entrez
  ontology <- methods::new(
    "topGOdata",
    ontology = "BP",
    allGenes = selected,
    nodeSize = as.integer(node_size),

    annot = topGO::annFUN.org,
    mapping = "org.Mm.eg.db",
    ID = "entrez"
  )
  primary <- topGO::runTest(ontology,
    algorithm = primary_algorithm,
    statistic = "fisher")
  classic <- topGO::runTest(ontology,
    algorithm = "classic",
    statistic = "fisher")
  ids <- topGO::usedGO(ontology)
  counts <- topGO::termStat(ontology, ids)
  primary_p <- topGO::score(primary)[ids]
  classic_p <- topGO::score(classic)[ids]
  result <- data.frame(
    GO_ID = ids,
    Term = vapply(
      ids, function(id) {
        term <- GO.db::GOTERM[[id]]
        if (is.null(term))
          NA_character_ else AnnotationDbi::Term(term)
      }, character(1)
    ),
    Annotated = counts[ids, "Annotated"],
    Significant = counts[ids, "Significant"],

    Expected = counts[ids, "Expected"],
    P_weight01 = unname(primary_p),

    P_classic = unname(classic_p)
  )
  result$Fold_enrichment <- result$Significant/result$Expected
  result$BH_weight01 <- p.adjust(result$P_weight01, method = "BH")
  result$BH_classic <- p.adjust(result$P_classic, method = "BH")
  list(
    table = result[order(result$P_weight01),
      ],
      universe = universe_entrez,
      foreground = foreground_entrez,
      algorithm = primary_algorithm,

    node_size = node_size,
    versions = sessionInfo()
  )
}

# An explicit configuration is required because the original Figure 5d
# foreground, background, nodeSize and annotation release were not recovered.
# Required columns: Population, Direction, P_field, P_cutoff, abs_logFC_min,
# node_size. This file must be supplied by the analyst.
configuration_file <- Sys.getenv("CORTEX_TOPGO_CONFIG")
stopifnot(
  nzchar(configuration_file),
  file.exists(configuration_file)
)
configuration <- read.csv(configuration_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(
  all(
    c("Population", "Direction", "P_field", "P_cutoff", "abs_logFC_min", "node_size") %in%
      names(configuration)
  )
)
topgo_output <- file.path(REPO, "objects", "topGO", "recomputed")
dir.create(topgo_output,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(configuration))) {
  settings <- configuration[i, ]
  input <- switch(
    settings$Population,
    VZ = "VZ_wt_vs_mut_DE_Litter_Sex_cor.csv",
    nonVZ = "nonVZ_wt_vs_mut_DE_Litter_Sex_cor.csv"
  )
  de <- read.csv(file.path(REPO, "data", "upstream", "RNA", input))
  # A tested-gene universe excludes genes with unavailable test statistics.
  de <- de[is.finite(de$PValue) &
    is.finite(de$logFC),
    ]
  de$ENSEMBL <- sub("[.][0-9]+$", "", de$gene_id)
  mapping <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db, keys = unique(de$ENSEMBL),
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    columns = "ENTREZID"
  )
  # All nonmissing mapped Entrez IDs are retained and deduplicated; one-to-many
  # mappings are not resolved by arbitrary first-row selection.
  de <- merge(de,
    mapping,
    by = "ENSEMBL",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE)
  p <- de[[settings$P_field]]
  stopifnot(
    length(p) ==
      nrow(de)
  )
  direction <- switch(
    settings$Direction,
    Up = de$logFC > 0,
    Down = de$logFC < 0,
    stop("Direction must be Up or Down")
  )
  selected <- !is.na(p) &
    p < settings$P_cutoff & abs(de$logFC) >=
    settings$abs_logFC_min & direction
  fit <- run_topgo_bp(
    universe_entrez = de$ENTREZID,
    foreground_entrez = de$ENTREZID[selected],

    node_size = settings$node_size
  )
  fit$configuration <- settings
  saveRDS(
    fit, file.path(topgo_output, paste0(settings$Population, "_", settings$Direction, ".rds"))
  )
}
```
## Recorded pseudobulk PCA procedure

The normalization is VST with blind=TRUE, followed by variance ranking and prcomp(center=TRUE, scale.=FALSE). PCA signs are arbitrary; the display notebooks record the sign used for manuscript orientation. Do not run a second transformation on the saved VST plotting matrix.

```{r rna-pseudobulk-pca, eval=isTRUE(params$run_pseudobulk)}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
pseudobulk_pca <- function(count_file) {
  counts <- as.matrix(read.csv(count_file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE))
  stopifnot(all(counts == round(counts)))
  counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

  sample_data <- data.frame(
    row.names = colnames(counts),
    Cluster = colnames(counts)
  )
  dataset <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(counts),
    colData = sample_data,
    design = ~1
  )
  transformed <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(DESeq2::vst(dataset, blind = TRUE))
  feature_variance <- apply(transformed, 1, var)
  selected <- names(sort(feature_variance, decreasing = TRUE))[1:500]

  prcomp(
    t(transformed[selected, , drop = FALSE]),
    center = TRUE,
    scale. = FALSE
  )
}
multiome_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "multiome")
rna_pca <- pseudobulk_pca(file.path(multiome_dir, "RNA_pseudobulk_counts.csv"))
atac_pca <- pseudobulk_pca(file.path(multiome_dir, "intervals_pseudobulk_counts.csv"))
```

## Extended Figure 7a/b expression

Stored RNA data-layer values and original UMAP; these are not SCT marker values.

```{r extended-figure-7a-b-expression-4}
d <- read_table("Extended_Fig7_KC", "7ab_Per_cell_RNA_expression")
d$Cluster <- factor(d$Cluster, levels = clusters)
for (g in c("Kdm6a", "Kdm6b")) {
  export_panel(
    umap_plot(d, g),
    paste0("Ext7/7a_", g, "_UMAP"),
    4, 4
  )
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Cluster, .data[[g]], fill = Cluster)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width",
      linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = MS$heatmap_cluster) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("_", "", x)) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),

      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      y = paste(g, "RNA log expression"),
      x = NULL
    )
  export_panel(
    p, paste0("Ext7/7b_", g, "_violin"),
    8, 3
  )
}
plot_rpkm(
  read_table("Extended_Fig7_KC", "7cde_jk_RPKM"),
  "Ext7/7cde_jk_RPKM"
)
```
